comparison.objective: Stop a moving ball before it reaches an edge; candidate tunes a shock absorber through repeated controlled impacts.
comparison.physical_skill: PR tests reactive interception of a free-moving object; candidate tests tool alignment, bimanual adjustment and locking, control actuation, and diagnosis across cycles.
comparison.success_condition: PR requires the ball stopped before falling; candidate requires two ≥0.85 J cycles within damper limits, with no bottoming, hard-stop strike, excessive rebound, overload, or drift.
comparison.reason: Both involve arresting motion, but reactive ball interception does not test adjustment of an energy absorber or setting retention. The PR has no specs or stated edge margin, final-speed, or contact constraints.
